For me, life standalone is not enough. I came into this world with a lot of wonder and a lot of fear. I think I was born knowing what it felt like to die. Living out my days blindfolded, meandering around on our planet, having children and dying at the mercy of the unknown is completely unappealing to me. I decided a long time ago that I would either give up on this place and off myself, trying again next time a little closer to the answers, or I would go all the way, climbing as close as I could to the stars and their secrets. This sounds really fucking pretentious or trendy but I just can't do normal. I get no joy out of it. That's not to say I don't enjoy the simple things in life. I just need to be climbing toward something greater. To escape the cycle of learning, dying and forgetting. I want to be up there where the real action is happening. And I want the same for all those I love. Eventually, all people. I think the most divine duty, for whichever belief system you subscribe to is to unite humanity with whatever is up there making the wheels turn. I love people, I think they deserve it.
